description: This file defines an adapter class for rendering a list of note objects in a RecyclerView within an Android application, including interaction handling and view binding logic.

classes.name: NoteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying a list of notes in a RecyclerView, manages view holders and data updates.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Replaces current items with new list of notes and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder object for a note item.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of note items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder for display at a given position.

inner_classes.name: NoteViewHolder
inner_classes.description: Holds view references for a note item and binds note data to views.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Sets note data into views and configures click listeners.
